overview.name: Styrene Butadiene Rubber (SBR)
overview.description: A synthetic rubber copolymer of styrene and butadiene, widely used in tire manufacturing and other industrial applications.
overview.overviewDescription: Styrene Butadiene Rubber represents one of the most important synthetic rubbers globally, serving as the backbone of the tire industry and countless other applications. This versatile elastomer combines the excellent abrasion resistance and low-temperature flexibility of butadiene with the strength and processability of styrene, creating a material that meets the demanding requirements of modern transportation and industrial applications. SBR's unique balance of properties makes it indispensable for tire treads, conveyor belts, footwear, and numerous other products that require durability, flexibility, and resistance to wear.
keyFeatures: Excellent abrasion resistance and wear properties
Good low-temperature flexibility and impact resistance
Versatile compounding capabilities for various applications
overview.industrialSignificance: SBR is the most widely used synthetic rubber globally, with annual production exceeding 5 million tons. Its dominance in tire manufacturing alone makes it crucial for the automotive and transportation industries, while its versatility enables applications across multiple industrial sectors.
